Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. The most recent version that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions — rollout confirmed.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident INC-0001 documenting the failure and the rollback, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was already healthy in production. The on-call engineer can now investigate the v2.3.1 regression.
